summary: Sony Group filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market buyback progress under its May 8, 2026 board authorization. In September 2026 it repurchased 6,892,400 common shares for ¥26,005,851,887 via a discretionary trading contract on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The authorization permits up to 230 million shares (3.89% of outstanding excluding treasury) or ¥500 billion through May 10, 2027. Cumulative repurchases total 74,473,700 shares for ¥263,357,992,192, roughly 53% of the yen cap used. Watch remaining capacity and any acceleration or expansion of the program.
